entities.summary: Abdullah, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Post-9/11 Reform and Arab Spring (2005–2015). Preceded by Arab Spring and King Abdullah Scholarship Program sends over 200,000 Saudis to study abroad. Their legacy influenced Saudi forces enter Bahrain to suppress the Arab Spring uprising.
